note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). The only contests were Cairncastle and Ardclinis (Carnlough); the other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. M'Auley (old member) 190; M'Gahan 57; majority 133.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ardclinis (Carnlough)' to Ardclinis (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Larne Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ardclinis; the rounds were filed as Ardclinis (1924, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Ardclinis (Carnlough) (1927). This round was filed as 'Ardclinis (Carnlough)', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ardclinis-carnlough) answers with a redirect to this one.
